pages.text: Perform Ornamental Finishing Works Competence BDCOF501 RQF Level: 5 Learning Hours 80 Credits: 8 Sector: Construction and Building Services Trade: Building Construction Module Type: Specific Curriculum: CBSBDC5001-TVET Certificate 5 in Building Construction Copyright: © Rwanda TVET Board, 2024 Issue Date: May 2024 2024-25

1 | P a g e Employable Skills for Sustainable Job Creation Purpose statement This specific module describes the skills, knowledge, and attitudes required to perform ornamental finishing works. It is meant for learners who have completed level IV in building construction and pursuing level V in building construction. At the end of this module, learners will be able to perform cladding installation, install glass, and apply paint coats. Learning assumed to be in place Ceiling installation, Acoustic and Thermal insulations, Scaffolding Operations, Roof construction, ArchiCAD software, Delivery modality Training delivery 100% Assessment Total 100% Theoretical content 30% Formative assessment 30% 50% Practical work: 70% 70% • Group project and presentation 20% • Individual project /Work 50% Summative Assessment 50% Elements of Competency and Performance Criteria Elements of competency Performance criteria 1. Perform Cladding Installation 1.1. Materials, tools, and equipment are properly selected based on project specifications and requirements. 1.2. Working area is properly prepared based on surface/site condition and cladding material type. 1.3. Masonry cladding is correctly performed according to the design pattern 1.4. Timber and metal cladding is properly installed according to the specified design pattern and details 1.5. Glass cladding is properly installed according to the design details 1.6. Alucobond cladding is properly installed according to the design details 1.7. Wallpaper is properly applied according to the design details 2. Install Glass 2.1. Glazing tools, equipment, and materials are properly prepared in accordance with the work specification

2 | P a g e Employable Skills for Sustainable Job Creation 2.2. Working area is properly prepared based on on-site conditions 2.3. Glasses are systematically fixed according to their methods 3. Apply Paint Coats 3.1. Materials, tools, and equipment are properly selected based on project specifications and requirements 3.2. Working area is properly prepared based on on-site conditions 3.3. The paint is correctly mixed according to paint specifications 3.4. Painting coats are systematically applied in accordance with the design 3.5. Working area is properly cleaned according to the standards Intended Knowledge, Skills and Attitude Knowledge Skills Attitude ✓ Identify materials, tools, and equipment ✓ Describe different types of ornamental finishes, ✓ Identify materials and tools used in ornamental finishing, including paints, varnishes, gilding materials ✓ Identify specialized finishing tools ✓ Identify color theory and how to achieve desired colour effects ✓ Identify catalogues, mood boards, and portfolios ✓ Interpret design drawings ✓ Perform various ornamental finishing techniques, ✓ Perform surfaces preparation for ornamental finishing ✓ Agility and attention to detail in the application of ornamental finishes ✓ Time management and organization skills to ensure efficient and high-quality work ✓ Perform assembling, joining, installation and mounting of cladding items ✓ Creativity and artistic sensibility to develop unique and aesthetically pleasing ornamental finishes ✓ Collaborative mind set to work effectively with other craftspeople, designers, and client ✓ Pay attention to the details in the finishing process ✓ Maintain cleanliness after works ✓ Willingness to continuously learn and improve skills, as ornamental finishing techniques and materials evolve

3 | P a g e Employable Skills for Sustainable Job Creation ✓ Identify assembling, joining, installation and mounting techniques ✓ Identify different cleaning methods ✓ Prepare catalogues, mood boards, and portfolios ✓ Apply new trends and styles in interior decoration ✓ Patience and dedication, as ornamental finishing often requires meticulous and time- consuming work Course content Learning outcomes At the end of the module the learner will be able to: 1. Perform cladding installation 2. Install glass 3. Apply paint coats Learning outcome 1. Perform Cladding Installation Learning hours: 30 Indicative content • Selection of materials, tools, and equipment used for cladding ✓ Identification of cladding materials Masonry cladding materials Timber cladding materials Wallpaper cladding materials Glass cladding materials Alucobond cladding materials ✓ Select cladding materials ✓ Classification of cladding Tools Mixing tools Batching tools Placing tools Measuring tools Cutting tools Levelling tools Cleaning tools ✓ Classification of cladding Equipment Personal protective equipment [PPE] Safety equipment Site work equipment ✓ Quantify cladding materials

4 | P a g e Employable Skills for Sustainable Job Creation • Preparation of working area ✓ Analyse working area condition Internal External ✓ Protecting and cleaning the work area ✓ Erecting scaffolding • Performing masonry cladding ✓ Develop a detailed design plan (dimensions and patterns) ✓ Measuring and marking ✓ Cutting ✓ Prepare the surface of the building (Set out) ✓ Apply mortar to the substrate ✓ Place the cladding materials ✓ Applying the finishing layer • Installation of timber /metal cladding ✓ Measuring and marking ✓ Cutting ✓ Set out ✓ Applying bond/fixing techniques ✓ Applying timber cladding cut-offs ✓ Applying the finishing layer • Installation of glass cladding ✓ Measuring and marking ✓ Cutting ✓ Adjust glass frame ✓ Apply adhesives ✓ Apply glass cladding panels ✓ Apply the finishing layer • Applying Alucobond cladding ✓ Install the Alucobond frame ✓ Prepare Alucobond panels Measure and cut the Alco bond panels to the required sizes Set out Perform folding or routing ✓ Install Alco bond Panels Attach the Alco bond panels to the substructure Secure the panels using rivets or screws ✓ Sealing the joints ✓ Peel off Alucobond protective coat • Applying wallpaper cladding ✓ Measuring and marking ✓ Cutting ✓ Set out

5 | P a g e Employable Skills for Sustainable Job Creation ✓ Apply adhesives ✓ Apply wallpaper cladding materials ✓ Apply the finishings Resources required for the indicative content Equipment • circular saw, band saw, router machine, surface planer, thickness planner, belt sander, grinder, jig saw, drilling machine, wheelbarrow, concrete mixer, scaffolding Materials • Paint, wooden board, nails, stones, timber, tiles, warning tapes, adhesive glue, screws, bolt, varnish, thinner, cement, sand, water, tile and or cladding materials, papers, glass, pencil Tools • Hammers, plumb bob, building line, measuring tape, spirit level, hand saws, machete, screwdrivers, spanners, squares, brush, files, rasps, marking gauge, bucket, jerry can or watering can Facilitation techniques Group discussion, scenario, simulation, individual activity • The trainer provides a summary of the classification of materials, tools, and equipment used for cladding and asks students to participate in the selection. • The trainer prepares a topic on the preparation of the working area and asks students to demonstrate the main activities in preparation for the working area. • The trainer displays a pages.text: Construct Roof Structure Competence BDCRC501 RQF Level: 5 Learning Hours 80 Credits: 8 Sector: Construction and Building Services Trade: Building Construction Module Type: Specific Curriculum: CBSBDC5001-TVET CERTIFICATE 5 IN BUILDING CONSTRUCTION Copyright: © Rwanda TVET Board, 2024 Issue Date: May 2024 2024-25

1 | P a g e Employable Skills for Sustainable Job Creation Purpose statement This module describes skills, knowledge and attitudes required to construct a roof structure. It is meant for learners who have successfully completed level IV in building construction and pursuing level V in building construction. At the end of this module students will be able to Perform roof preliminary works, set out the roof, fix roof and apply roof coverings with minimum supervision. Leaning assumed to be in place Scaffolding operations, Basic reinforced concrete design, ARCHICAD software. Delivery modality Training delivery 100% Assessment Total 100% Theoretical content 30% Formative assessment 30% 50% Practical work: 70% 70% • Group project and presentation 20% • Individual project /Work 50% Summative Assessment 50% Elements of Competency and Performance Criteria Elements of competency Performance criteria Perform roof preliminary works 1.1. Roof plan is correctly interpreted based on drawing details. 1.2. Safety precautions are effectively respected/applied according to the working condition. 1.3. Materials, tools and equipment are properly prepared based on project specifications. Set out roof 2.1. Working place is adequately prepared according to the site condition 2.2. Method of setting out is appropriately applied according to the type of roof 2.3. Measurements of roof structure are properly checked referring to the roof plan. 2.4. Reference line is accurately fixed according to the type of roof

2 | P a g e Employable Skills for Sustainable Job Creation 2.5. Roof slope is properly regulated according to the roof plan 2.6. Size of gutters are properly determined based on roof catchment area 2.7. Gutters and valleys are properly set according to drawings and specification Fix roof structure 3.1. Shape of trusses is properly identified according to drawings and specifications. 3.2. Truss members are correctly assembled according to drawings and specifications. 3.3. Roof members are properly fixed according to drawings and specifications 3.4. Protective materials are properly applied according to the type of roof material and specifications 3.5. Stability of roof structure is effectively ensured according to the techniques of fixing Apply roof coverings 4.1. Status of materials is adequately verified according to the specifications. 4.2. Drainage gutters and valleys are appropriately installed according to roof drawings. 4.3. Insulation materials are installed according to roof drawings. 4.4. Roof coverings and ridge covers are properly fixed according to roof drawings. 4.5. Protective/Sealant materials are properly applied based on project specification. 4.6. Roof is appropriately checked in accordance with the roof drawing.

3 | P a g e Employable Skills for Sustainable Job Creation Intended Knowledge, Skills and Attitude Knowledge Skills Attitude ✓ Describe the methods of removing hazard and risk ✓ Describe types of materials, tools and equipment required in construction ✓ Identify shape of trusses ✓ Identify parts of roof ✓ Describe the process of fixing roof and roof coverings ✓ Describe insulation materials for roof covering ✓ Identify methods of setting out roof ✓ Perform cutting methods ✓ Interpret construction drawings ✓ Perform assembling techniques ✓ Carry out finishing activities ✓ Set out roofs ✓ Apply roof coverings ✓ Manage the wastes ✓ Prepare technical report of the work done ✓ Use materials efficiently and effectively ✓ Demonstrate punctuality during the implementation of design project ✓ Demonstrate resourcefulness in the new design trends ✓ Demonstrate effective communication skills to stakeholders. ✓ Manage time effectively to meet project timelines ✓ Having teamwork and collaboration spirit ✓ Demonstrate ethical practices at the workplace ✓ Demonstrate willingness to adapt to changes in roof works ✓ Practice compliance with health, safety, social and environmental regulations ✓ Listen to clients’ needs open-mindedly ✓ Pay attention to details while making a roof

4 | P a g e Employable Skills for Sustainable Job Creation Course content Learning outcomes At the end of the module the learner will be able to: 1. Perform roof preliminary works 2. Set out roof structures 3. Fix roof structure 4.
